title: Congo Ebola Outbreak Spreads Faster Than Any in History
subtitle: Health officials report that the current crisis has reached a grim milestone of 1,000 deaths in record time.

summary.en: A new Ebola outbreak in Congo has resulted in over 1,000 deaths. This current crisis is spreading much faster than the major 2014-2016 epidemic. The virus involved is a rare variant for which there are no approved vaccines or medical treatments. Most cases are currently limited to the eastern part of Congo near the border with Uganda. Health experts warn that the peak of the outbreak may still be ahead.
summary.zh: 剛果新一波伊波拉疫情已造成超過一千人死亡。目前的危機擴散速度遠快於二零一四至二零一六年的大型疫情。此次涉及的病毒是一種罕見變異株，目前尚無核准的疫苗或醫療療法。大多數病例目前侷限於剛果東部靠近烏干達邊界的地區。衛生專家警告，疫情高峰可能尚未到來。

paragraphs.en: The Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo has reached a sad and serious milestone. According to MedPage Today, the disease has now killed more than 1,000 people. This number is significant because it was reached nearly three times faster than the 2014-2016 Ebola epidemic, which was previously considered the worst in history. While that earlier outbreak took eight months to reach 1,000 deaths, the current crisis hit that same number in just over two months.
paragraphs.zh: 剛果民主共和國的伊波拉病毒疫情已達到一個令人悲傷且嚴峻的里程碑。根據醫學新聞網站 MedPage Today 的報導，該疾病目前已奪走超過一千條人命。這個數字之所以顯著，是因為其達到此規模的速度，比先前被視為史上最嚴重的二零一四至二零一六年伊波拉疫情快了近三倍。當時那場疫情花了八個月才累積一千起死亡病例，而目前的危機僅在兩個多月內就達到同樣的數字。

paragraphs.en: Data from Congo's Ministry of Health shows that as of this Tuesday, there have been 2,536 confirmed cases of the virus. The outbreak was officially declared on May 15. Because the virus is moving so quickly, medical teams are facing extreme pressure. The 2014-2016 epidemic lasted for about three years, eventually recording more than 28,000 cases and over 11,000 deaths. Experts are worried that the current situation could follow a similarly difficult path if it is not brought under control soon.
paragraphs.zh: 來自剛果衛生部的數據顯示，截至本週二，已確認有兩千五百三十六起病毒感染病例。該疫情於五月十五日正式宣布爆發。由於病毒傳播速度極快，醫療團隊正面臨極大的壓力。二零一四至二零一六年的疫情持續了約三年，最終記錄到超過兩萬八千起病例及逾一萬一千人死亡。專家擔憂，若無法儘快控制疫情，目前的情況可能會走上同樣艱難的道路。

paragraphs.en: One major challenge is the type of virus involved. The World Health Organization explains that Ebola is actually a group of different viruses. The 2014-2016 outbreak was caused by the standard Ebola virus, which is the most common and deadliest type. However, this year’s outbreak is caused by the Bundibugyo virus. This is a rare variant, and importantly, there are currently no approved vaccines or specific treatments available to fight it. Without these tools, doctors have fewer ways to protect the public or help those who are already sick.
paragraphs.zh: 其中一項主要挑戰在於病毒的類型。世界衛生組織（World Health Organization）解釋，伊波拉實際上是一組不同病毒的統稱。二零一四至二零一六年的疫情是由標準伊波拉病毒所引起，這是最常見且最致命的類型。然而，今年的疫情是由邦迪布吉歐病毒（Bundibugyo virus）所引起。這是一種罕見的變異株，且重要的是，目前尚無核准的疫苗或特定療法可用於對抗它。缺乏這些工具，醫師保護大眾或協助病患的能力便受到限制。

paragraphs.en: At the moment, the outbreak is mostly limited to Congo. Specifically, it is contained within five provinces in the eastern region of the country, which is near the border with Uganda. While there have been a few cases reported in Uganda, the spread has not reached the global scale seen during the 2014-2016 period. During that earlier time, the virus spread widely across Guinea, Liberia, and Sierra Leone, and even reached the United States and Europe. While the current geographic reach is smaller, the speed of the spread within the affected region remains a primary concern for health authorities.
paragraphs.zh: 目前，疫情主要侷限於剛果境內。具體而言，它被控制在該國東部靠近烏干達邊界的五個省份。雖然烏干達已通報零星病例，但傳播範圍尚未達到二零一四至二零一六年期間所見的全球規模。在當時，病毒在幾內亞、賴比瑞亞與獅子山共和國廣泛傳播，甚至蔓延至美國與歐洲。儘管目前的地理影響範圍較小，但病毒在受災地區內的擴散速度，仍是衛生當局首要關切的問題。

paragraphs.en: Officials report that the case fatality rate—the percentage of people who die after catching the disease—is currently 40%. For comparison, the 2014-2016 outbreak had a fatality rate of 39.6%. According to the CDC, the standard Ebola virus can be much deadlier, with up to 90% of cases being fatal if patients do not receive medical care. Health officials believe that many of the deaths in the current outbreak are happening because patients are reporting their symptoms too late. When people wait too long to seek help, it becomes much harder for medical teams to save them.
paragraphs.zh: 官員指出，目前的致死率（即感染該疾病後死亡的人數比例）為百分之四十。作為對比，二零一四至二零一六年的疫情致死率為百分之三十九點六。根據美國疾病管制與預防中心（CDC）的說法，標準伊波拉病毒可能更為致命，若病患未接受醫療照護，致死率最高可達百分之九十。衛生官員認為，目前疫情中許多死亡案例是因為病患太晚通報症狀。當人們拖延太久才尋求協助，醫療團隊要拯救他們就變得困難許多。

paragraphs.en: There is still a great deal of uncertainty regarding what will happen next. Officials noted that the peak of the outbreak might not have arrived yet. Several factors make the situation difficult to predict. First, the "patient zero," or the very first person to catch the virus, has not been confirmed. This makes it harder for researchers to understand how the outbreak started. Additionally, many of the new cases are coming from people who were not previously being monitored by health workers. There were also early delays in identifying the specific variant behind the virus, which slowed down the initial response.
paragraphs.zh: 關於接下來會發生什麼，仍存在極大的不確定性。官員指出，疫情高峰可能尚未到來。多項因素使得情況難以預測。首先，所謂的「零號病人」，也就是最初感染病毒的人，尚未被確認。這使得研究人員更難以釐清疫情是如何開始的。此外，許多新增病例來自先前未受衛生工作者監控的人群。初期在辨識病毒背後的特定變異株時也出現延誤，這減緩了最初的應對速度。

paragraphs.en: As the situation continues to develop, the focus remains on tracking new cases and trying to limit the movement of the virus. Because the outbreak is moving at such an unusual speed, health organizations are working to improve their monitoring systems. The goal is to identify sick individuals as quickly as possible to prevent further spread. For now, the world is watching closely as medical workers in Congo fight to contain this fast-moving and dangerous disease.
paragraphs.zh: 隨著局勢持續發展，重點仍放在追蹤新增病例並設法限制病毒的移動。由於疫情正以異常的速度擴散，衛生組織正致力於改善監控系統。目標是儘快識別患病個體，以防止進一步蔓延。目前，全世界正密切關注剛果的醫療人員如何奮力控制這種傳播迅速且危險的疾病。

keyTerms.definitionEn: To reach a specific level, number, or point.
keyTerms.noteZh: 常見作動詞（打擊），這裡指達到某個數量。文中：the current crisis hit that same number in just over two months.

keyTerms.definitionEn: To manage or limit something so that it does not become worse or out of hand.
keyTerms.noteZh: 這是常見的片語，指將失控的局面恢復掌控。文中：Experts are worried that the current situation could follow a similarly difficult path if it is not brought under control soon.

keyTerms.definitionEn: The time when something is at its highest, strongest, or most intense point.
keyTerms.noteZh: 常見作名詞（山峰），這裡指疫情最嚴重的時期。文中：Officials noted that the peak of the outbreak might not have arrived yet.

previousArticles.summaryEn: The Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo has now claimed over 1,000 lives. Health experts report that this is the fastest-spreading Ebola epidemic ever recorded. Medical teams are facing major challenges, including armed conflict and a lack of funding. Many people are avoiding treatment centers due to fear and social stigma. Researchers are now exploring whether existing vaccines might offer protection against the specific virus strain currently spreading.

quiz.question: How does the speed of the current Ebola outbreak in Congo compare to the 2014-2016 epidemic?

options.A: It is moving at approximately the same speed as the previous epidemic.
options.B: It reached 1,000 deaths nearly three times faster than the previous epidemic.
options.C: It has already resulted in more total deaths than the 2014-2016 epidemic.
options.D: It took eight months to reach 1,000 deaths, which is slower than the previous epidemic.

quiz.explanationZh: 正確答案為 B。根據文章第一段，文中明確指出此次疫情達到 1,000 例死亡的速度比 2014-2016 年的疫情快了近三倍。選項 A 錯誤，因為兩者速度明顯不同；選項 C 錯誤，因為 2014-2016 年疫情死亡人數超過 11,000 人，目前尚未超越此數據；選項 D 錯誤，因為文章提到 2014-2016 年疫情才花了八個月達到 1,000 例，而非此次。

quiz.question: Based on the information provided, why might medical teams be finding it particularly difficult to manage the current outbreak?

options.A: The virus has already spread to the United States and Europe, creating a global emergency.
options.B: The current variant is the standard Ebola virus, which is known to be 90% fatal.
options.C: The lack of specific vaccines and the late arrival of patients for treatment are hindering containment efforts.
options.D: The Ministry of Health has stopped tracking cases because the virus is moving too quickly to monitor.

quiz.explanationZh: 正確答案為 C。綜合文章第三段（缺乏疫苗與治療工具）與第五段（患者就醫太晚導致難以救治），可以推論這些因素共同增加了醫療團隊的壓力。選項 A 錯誤，文章指出目前疫情主要侷限在剛果；選項 B 錯誤，文章說明此次為較罕見的 Bundibugyo 變異株，而非標準型；選項 D 錯誤，文章提到衛生組織正在努力改善監控系統，並未停止追蹤。

quiz.question: In the final paragraph, what does the word 'monitoring' mean in the context of health organizations?

options.A: Observing and tracking the progress of something.
options.B: Giving advice to patients about their lifestyle.
options.C: Providing financial support to affected families.
options.D: Creating new laws to restrict international travel.

quiz.explanationZh: 正確答案為 A。在文章中，monitoring 指的是衛生組織對疫情發展、新病例出現與患者狀況的持續觀察與追蹤。選項 B、C、D 皆與醫療體系在疫情期間進行「監測」或「追蹤」病情的專業行為無直接關聯，故皆為錯誤選項。

quiz.question: What is the primary concern regarding the current Ebola outbreak in Congo?

options.A: The virus has become more deadly than any other disease in human history.
options.B: The outbreak is being ignored by international health authorities.
options.C: The rapid speed of the virus's spread within the region and the challenges in controlling it.
options.D: The virus has already caused more deaths than the 2014-2016 epidemic.

quiz.explanationZh: 正確答案為 C。文章的核心主旨在於討論此次 Ebola 疫情擴散速度極快，且因缺乏疫苗、患者延誤就醫與變異株特性，使得控制疫情變得非常困難。選項 A 過度誇大；選項 B 與事實相反，國際組織正密切關注；選項 D 數據錯誤，目前死亡人數尚未超過 2014-2016 年的總數。
